entity.title: SyncConfig
entity.description: The schema for the steerspec-sync.yml configuration file.

rules.body: IS the schema for the `steerspec-sync.yml` configuration file.
MUST be expressed as a YAML file named `steerspec-sync.yml` at the repository root.
MUST contain a `version` field specifying the config schema version in semver format.
MUST contain an `auth` section specifying the authentication method.
MAY contain a `variables` section for global template variables.
MUST contain a `templates` section defining one or more templates.
MUST contain a `targets` section defining the ComponentRegistry.
MAY contain a `sync` section for sync behavior configuration.
MAY contain a `monitor` section for monitoring behavior configuration.
MAY contain a `conflicts` section for conflict detection configuration.
The `auth` section MUST specify a `method` which MUST be one of: "github-app", "pat", "github-token".
The "github-app" method IS RECOMMENDED for production use due to better rate limits and audit trails.
When using "github-app", the section MUST include `app-id` and `private-key` fields.
When using "pat" or "github-token", the section MUST include a `token` field.
The `sync` section MAY define `concurrency` as an integer (default: 5) controlling parallel PR creation.
The `sync` section MAY define `pr-label` as a string (default: "steerspec-sync").
The `sync` section MAY define `close-stale-prs` as a boolean (default: true).
The `sync` section MAY define `dry-run` as a boolean (default: false).
The `monitor` section MAY define `schedule` as a cron expression (default: "0 8 * * 1" -- weekly Monday 08:00 UTC).
The `monitor` section MAY define `issue-label` as a string (default: "steerspec-drift").
The `monitor` section MAY define `auto-close` as a boolean (default: true) controlling whether resolved drift issues are auto-closed.
The `conflicts` section MAY define `schedule` as a cron expression (default: "0 9 * * 1" -- weekly Monday 09:00 UTC).
The `conflicts` section MAY define `tiers` as a list of enabled detection tiers (default: [1, 2]).
The default `conflicts.tiers` value MUST NOT include tier 3 (LLM-assisted), so tier 3 runs only when the configuration or the `tiers` action input requests it explicitly.
The `conflicts` section MAY define `issue-label` as a string (default: "steerspec-conflict").
When using "github-app", the `app-id` and `private-key` fields MAY reference secrets.
When using "pat" or "github-token", the `token` field MAY reference secrets.
